desc: Ideation complete: identify the reduced row/column XOR formulation and parity DSU as the primary approach.
Implement the complete Python solution for the primary approach, reading all test cases from stdin and writing answers to stdout.
For each test case, compute row and column parity of A cells; if any row or column has odd A parity, output 0 and skip DSU work.
Handle all-B and all-A shortcut cases correctly.
Initialize a parity DSU on H+W nodes representing row bits and column bits, with path compression, union by size, xor-to-parent values, contradiction detection, and component counting.
While scanning the grid, maintain row-prefix and column-prefix parities of A cells; for each B cell, union its row and column variables with the correct xor label.
Count valid placements as 2^(DSU components) modulo 998244353 when consistent, otherwise output 0.
Run the implementation on the provided sample tests and confirm the outputs are 2, 0, and 2.
